role_sources.title: Role Sources
role_sources.description: Audit externally managed agent roles, immutable versions, and proposed workspace changes.
role_sources.read_only_notice: Plan approval and apply remain read-only until production gates pass. Workspace admins can use controlled lifecycle actions and request read-only scans below.
role_sources.controlled_apply_notice: Controlled apply is enabled for workspace owners and admins. Review the exact plan, make every archive decision explicitly, approve it, and confirm once more before applying.
role_sources.lifecycle_description: Pause work before detaching or moving a source. Resume requires a fresh online runtime and matching loaded-configuration evidence.
role_sources.lifecycle_admin_only: Only workspace owners and admins can change lifecycle state.
role_sources.lifecycle_history_empty: No lifecycle changes have been recorded.
role_sources.lifecycle_confirm_pause: Pausing immediately cancels queued or claimed scans and destroys unconsumed secret transfers. Materialized workers and historical evidence remain unchanged.
role_sources.lifecycle_confirm_resume: Resume only succeeds when the bound runtime is fresh and has proven that it loaded this exact adapter configuration.
role_sources.lifecycle_confirm_detach: Detaching releases the runtime binding for retirement. The source remains historical and cannot scan or apply until it is rebound and separately resumed.
role_sources.rebind_description: Choose a registered runtime in this workspace and enter its daemon-local config handle. An offline runtime may be rebound, but the source stays paused until fresh loaded evidence exists.
role_sources.rebind_runtimes_failed: Couldn't load workspace runtimes. Close and try again.
role_sources.rebind_runtimes_empty: No registered runtime is available in this workspace.
role_sources.lifecycle_failed: Unable to update the role-source lifecycle.
role_sources.sources_description: Register a trusted adapter against a daemon-local configuration, then wait for matching loaded evidence before scanning.
role_sources.create_boundary: Paths and credentials stay on the selected Runtime; this UI sends only a local configuration handle.
role_sources.create_private_config_notice: First create the source configuration in the Runtime's private daemon config. Never paste a filesystem path, URL credential, signing key, token, or source content here.
role_sources.create_config_help: This is the non-secret ID already defined on the selected Runtime. Registration does not prove that it is loaded; wait for matching Runtime evidence before scanning.
role_sources.create_success: Role source registered. Waiting for matching Runtime evidence.
role_sources.create_failed: Unable to register the role source.
role_sources.create_invalid_response: The source may have been registered, but its response was invalid. Refresh before trying again.
role_sources.empty_hint: Create the private configuration on a Runtime, then use Register source to bind its non-secret handle.
role_sources.runtime_attestations_description: Distinct redacted configuration states that this runtime durably reported; no paths, raw configuration, or secrets are retained.
role_sources.runtime_attestations_empty: This runtime has not reported loaded-configuration evidence yet.
role_sources.scan_description: Queue a source inspection that records an immutable snapshot and proposed plan without changing digital workers, skills, automations, or running tasks.
role_sources.scan_empty: No scan has been requested for this source yet.
role_sources.scan_admin_only: Only workspace owners and admins can request a scan.
role_sources.scan_request_failed: Unable to request the read-only scan.
role_sources.scan_already_active: A scan is already queued or running. Its status will refresh here.
role_sources.scan_source_state: Resume this role source before requesting a scan.
role_sources.scan_request_conflict: This scan request belongs to another operator. Refresh the status before retrying.
role_sources.scan_invalid_response: The scan was queued, but its status response was invalid. Refresh before requesting another scan.
role_sources.scan_history_description: Bounded, redacted timeline of recent read-only scans, stable failure codes, snapshots, adapter versions, and completion times.
role_sources.scan_history_empty: No scan history is available for this source.
role_sources.scan_history_no_matches: No recent scans match these filters.
role_sources.scan_recovery_retry: Check runtime and network health, then request a new scan; the previous request remains immutable.
role_sources.scan_recovery_trust: Do not retry blindly. Verify the publisher identity, active signing key and revision policy before scanning again.
role_sources.scan_recovery_runtime: Repair or reload this source configuration on the bound daemon, confirm matching loaded evidence, then scan again.
role_sources.scan_recovery_source: Stabilize and validate the source bundle or artifacts, then request a fresh scan rather than reusing this result.
role_sources.scan_recovery_unknown: Use the stable code for incident correlation and inspect daemon health before requesting a new scan.
role_sources.snapshot_history_description: Compare immutable source versions by stable role, skill, and capability identity.
role_sources.snapshot_history_minimum: At least two verified snapshots are required for comparison.
role_sources.snapshot_content_boundary: This view returns only object identity and added, changed, or removed status. Manifest bodies, artifact paths, environment keys, and MCP configuration stay on the server.
role_sources.snapshot_comparison_load_failed: Couldn't load this verified snapshot comparison.
role_sources.snapshot_no_changes: These snapshots contain no object-level changes.
role_sources.latest_plan_description: Review the deterministic plan produced for {{name}} before controlled approval.
role_sources.plan_load_failed: Couldn't load the latest role-source plan.
role_sources.no_plan: No scan plan is available for this source yet.
role_sources.plan_blocked: Blocked — no changes can be applied
role_sources.plan_requires_scan: A successful read-only scan is required before generating a plan.
role_sources.plan_create_failed: Unable to generate the role-source plan.
role_sources.plan_invalid_response: The plan may have been generated, but its response was invalid. Refresh before trying again.
role_sources.configuration_review_description: Review only role ID, environment-key or MCP-server ID, and operation. Values, value digests, definitions, URLs, commands, arguments, and headers are never returned to this view.
role_sources.configuration_review_load_failed: Couldn't load the plan-bound configuration review.
role_sources.configuration_review_empty: This plan does not change environment keys or MCP servers.
role_sources.configuration_review_more: {{count}} additional changes are omitted from this bounded review.
role_sources.more_actions: {{count}} additional actions are omitted from this preview
role_sources.impact_description: Point-in-time preview. Queued work is rechecked at apply; running work continues on its captured version.
role_sources.impact_load_failed: Couldn't load the operational impact preview.
role_sources.no_active_tasks: No active tasks are affected at this moment.
role_sources.impact_truncated: This preview is truncated. Aggregate counts above include all affected work.
role_sources.approval_description: Every archive candidate requires an explicit retain or archive choice. Approval is bound to this exact plan digest.
role_sources.archive_none: This plan has no archive candidates.
role_sources.adoption_description: Each row names one existing unmanaged object. Confirming adopts only that immutable object identity; any later change blocks the whole apply.
role_sources.approval_not_recorded: No usable approval has been recorded for this plan.
role_sources.approval_failed: Unable to record the plan approval.
role_sources.approval_invalid_response: The approval may have been recorded, but its response was invalid. Refresh before trying again.
role_sources.secret_transfer_description: Request a short-lived server challenge for each role. The bound daemon automatically returns encrypted environment and MCP values; this page never displays plaintext, keys, or ciphertext.
role_sources.secret_transfer_failed: Unable to request the secure transfer.
role_sources.secret_transfer_invalid_response: The transfer may have been requested, but its status response was invalid. Refresh before retrying.
role_sources.apply_confirm_description: Plan {{digest}} will create {{create}}, update {{update}}, and archive {{archive}} objects. The server rechecks permissions, source state, snapshot CAS, approval, capacity, and required secret transfers before committing.
role_sources.apply_succeeded: Role-source plan applied and receipt verified.
role_sources.apply_failed: Unable to apply the role-source plan.
role_sources.apply_invalid_response: The apply result could not be verified. Reconcile successful receipts before retrying.
role_sources.receipts_description: Server-verified, content-addressed receipts for completed apply operations.
role_sources.receipts_empty: No successful apply receipts have been recorded for this source.
role_sources.receipt_counts: Created {{created}} · adopted {{adopted}} · updated {{updated}} · unchanged {{unchanged}} · archived {{archived}} · retained {{retained}}
role_sources.rollback_confirm_description: The server will create a new audited plan targeting historical snapshot {{digest}}. Nothing is changed yet. You must review impact and archive decisions, obtain a new exact approval, refresh any required secret transfers, and confirm apply separately.
role_sources.rollback_plan_created: Forward rollback plan created for review.
role_sources.rollback_plan_failed: Unable to create the forward rollback plan.
role_sources.rollback_invalid_response: The rollback plan may have been created, but its response was invalid. Refresh before trying again.
role_sources.legal_holds_description: Owner-only retention controls for investigations, litigation, regulatory duties, customer requests, and security incidents.
role_sources.legal_holds_warning: An active hold blocks workspace deletion and future evidence pruning. It does not pause scanning or applying changes.
role_sources.legal_holds_empty: No legal holds have been recorded for this source.
role_sources.legal_hold_create_description: Choose a closed reason code and scope. Case details stay in your approved external system; Multica stores only an optional SHA-256 commitment.
role_sources.legal_hold_failed: Unable to manage the legal hold.
role_sources.legal_hold_reference_hint: Use an approved high-entropy or HMAC-derived commitment, not a predictable case number or free text.
role_sources.legal_hold_release_description: Releasing is a separate append-only event. Existing evidence remains until an approved retention job removes it.
role_sources.retention_description: Owner-approved snapshot retention with legal-hold, rollback, task-pin, and in-flight-work protection.
role_sources.retention_load_failed: Couldn't load the retention policy and preview.
role_sources.retention_policy_summary: Snapshots must be at least {{days}} days old; the latest {{count}} successfully applied versions are always reserved.
role_sources.retention_preview_summary: {{count}} snapshots currently eligible · up to {{bytes}} of referenced artifacts
role_sources.retention_preview_unique_reclaim: Projected uniquely reclaimable artifacts after all current candidates prune: {{bytes}}
role_sources.retention_preview_warning: This is a live projection, not realized storage savings or a deletion promise. The worker rechecks legal holds, task pins, current mappings, active transfers/applies, recent plans, and rollback reserves; permanent purge and its tombstone tail must finish separately.
role_sources.retention_purge_receipt_summary: {{count}} completed purge receipts · {{bytes}} of logical artifact bodies confirmed absent
role_sources.retention_purge_receipt_warning: Each receipt verifies exact-key absence after the full permanent-purge tombstone tail. {{bytes}} of object-version bytes were directly observed and deleted. This is storage evidence, not provider billing savings.
role_sources.retention_purge_receipt_incomplete: {{count}} receipts include {{attempts}} purge attempts whose provider response was lost, partial, or abandoned. Exact-key absence is verified, but version and observed-byte totals are lower bounds; reconcile provider evidence before volume or billing claims.
role_sources.retention_purge_receipt_evidence_lower_b: {{attempts}} ambiguous attempts · provider counts are lower bounds
role_sources.retention_purge_receipt_truncated: The newest 50 verified receipts are shown; totals cover the full immutable ledger.
role_sources.retention_preview_truncated: Preview details are limited to 200 snapshots; the worker remains bounded per sweep.
role_sources.retention_edit_warning: Enabling this policy can permanently remove old snapshot manifests and make versions outside the rollback reserve unavailable. Artifact bodies are reclaimed later by the independently gated permanent-purge worker.
role_sources.retention_update_failed: Unable to update the retention policy.
role_sources.failed_applies_description: Append-only, content-free evidence recorded independently after the mutation request returns an error.
role_sources.failed_applies_commit_notice: A commit-stage entry means the automatic receipt check did not confirm success. Do not assume rollback; reconcile it against successful receipts before recovery.
role_sources.failed_apply_recovery_reconcile: First reconcile current source state and successful receipts. Never infer rollback from a timeout, cancellation, or commit-stage error.
role_sources.failed_apply_recovery_secret: Request fresh short-lived secret transfers for the current exact approval before returning to the plan; expired or mismatched transfers cannot be reused.
role_sources.failed_apply_recovery_retry: Reconcile receipts first. If the exact plan is still current and approved, resolve capacity or dependency health, then return to the plan and use a new separately confirmed apply request.
role_sources.failed_apply_recovery_rebuild: Refresh and run a new read-only scan. Rebuild and reapprove the plan; do not reuse a stale plan after state, target, or policy conflicts.
role_sources.failed_apply_reconciled: Current source, scan, plan, receipt, and failure evidence refreshed.
role_sources.no_failed_applies: No failed apply attempts have been recorded for this source.
